functions.recoveredRole: Refresh the available-curve list after the Nodal Voltages or Outputs filter changes
functions.behavior: Passes the Add Curve form and a false override value to the shared list-rebuild function. The rebuilt available-curves list reflects both VoltagesCB.Checked and OutputsCB.Checked with the other category and text filters; the selected-curves list is unchanged.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds both VoltagesCB.OnClick and OutputsCB.OnClick to address 013cb330 under the handler name VoltagesCBClick. The recovered body contains only FUN_013cab80(param_1, 0). The published TAddCurveDlg field table maps VoltagesCB to +0x7a0 and OutputsCB to +0x7c0. FUN_013cab80 reads +0x7c0 to gate three recovered output registries while it repopulates AvailableCurvesLB.
